en.html:
Be frantic, take it easy—time went on at its usual speed. School happened. Lessons happened.

Listening properly, I was in no condition for that. But skip now, and the commotion would only grow. 'I'm going to find Ritsu' would not get me permission.

I did not want to trouble the school, or, especially, the Kurusunos. Uncle and Auntie were looking after an orphan who was only a distant relative. I could not go making them worry.

...If my own parents had raised me, would I try leaning on them at a time like this?

No idea. I did not even remember their faces. They died in an accident, I had been told.

Anyway, best course available: wait for school to finish, then act.

As for the lesson... sorry, sir. Suzukawa was doing his duty, probably feeling much as we did. Still, today I would have to let it pass through.

ja.html:
焦ろうがのんびりしていようが時間は普通に流れる
し、学校は普通にあるし、授業は普通に行われる。

　正直、授業なんかまともに聞いていられる気分では
なかったが、この状況でさぼったりすれば騒ぎを助長
してしまう。
　リツを探しに行くと断っても通るわけがない。

　学校と、特にご厄介になっている来栖野家に迷惑を
掛けることは避けたかった。
　遠縁の孤児に過ぎないおれの面倒をみてくれている
おじさんおばさんを心配させるわけにはいかない。

　……実の両親に育てられている身なら、こういう時
はむしろ、頼ろうとするのだろうか？
　などとちらりと考えたが、わからなかった。事故で
死んだ（と聞く）両親のことは顔も覚えていない。

　何にせよおれは最善の手段、放課後を待っての行動
を選ぶしかなかった。
　授業は……同じような心境だろうに責務を果たして
いる鈴川には申し訳ないが、聞き流させてもらう。

鈴川"...Ancient, medieval, early modern, modern, contemporary. History is one long affair; making manageable pieces out of it is called periodization."
鈴川"Until last time, modern history. From today, contemporary. Very neat division, except—"
鈴川"Where exactly to cut, people do not agree. Several views exist. In one, the new-type tsurugi is born, and there begins the contemporary age."
鈴川"From antiquity right up to now, the tsurugi has been the strongest weapon. Physical ability goes up enormously, the wearer flies freely. Better than this, we still have not produced."
鈴川"On land, tanks. In the air, flying ships. Powerful weapons, both. Nobody is insulting them. But 'powerful' does not mean 'strongest,' understand. In simple fighting power, the tsurugi is still well ahead."
鈴川"Work on bringing it down continues. HVAP, for instance. During our war, the railgun project attracted much attention. Attention is one thing; practical use is another. Almost none have reached it."
鈴川"A weapon that defeats a tsurugi, none. A weapon safe from defeat by a tsurugi, also none. One wearer, if so inclined, can wipe out a hundred fully armed infantry. One man, a hundred men. That is the comparison."
鈴川"...No. Even that is insufficient. Some, it seems, can destroy a town by themselves."
鈴川"Legends of this sort, every country has. Our particular misfortune is that we citizens of Yamato cannot leave them in the fairy-tale category. Real threat, we must treat them as. Very unfortunate indeed."
雄飛"..."

鈴川"That much power, the tsurugi possesses. Its user is called a musha."
鈴川"Before the modern age, these warriors came only from a handful of upper warrior families. Why this small supply? Takano."
ｅｔｃ／高野"Because tsurugi were precious, sir."
鈴川"'Precious' is the answer. Now give me the reason behind the answer."
ｅｔｃ／高野"One smith could make only one."
鈴川"Correct. For a smith, one forging in a lifetime. To finish the armor, his own body and soul must be hammered into it. This is called 'passing through the shingane.'"
鈴川"Only then does the armor get its supreme power, and a brain to direct that power according to the user's will. Leave out the heart-steel, what remains? A very well-made suit of armor. Very well-made is not the same thing."
鈴川"One finished tsurugi requires one smith's life. 'Precious,' then, is not merely a compliment to the workmanship."
ｅｔｃ／吉田"Sir!"

鈴川 「つまり、劔冑を一領造るには鍛冶師が命を 一つ捧げなくてはならないわけだ。 　貴重品なのは当然だな」
ｅｔｃ／吉田 「先生っ」

鈴川"What is it, Yoshida?"
ｅｔｃ／吉田"Then does the smith die after making it?"
鈴川"...Now that is not so simple. The soul stays as the armor's OS. Look from that side, and you can say the smith lives."
鈴川"But do not let that 'lives' carry everything away with it. A component's mind—or something like one—is what remains. Humanity is almost entirely gone. Commands, it answers. Action on its own initiative, no."
鈴川"Some say there once were tsurugi of a different kind. That takes us beyond legend. Probably none remain now."
鈴川"So. Until the modern age, very few warriors. We have arrived at the reason, not merely repeated that they were few."
鈴川"The same problem existed worldwide. Then, National Year 2549: Ziegler, arms maker of the Habsburg, completed a tsurugi without consuming its smith's life. First time anywhere. The situation changed completely."

en.html:
鈴川"Before that, 2544. What happened then? Anyone knows?"
忠保"Yes."
鈴川"Inagi."
忠保"Professor Follett of the Britain was researching the Mirror for clone. The work stalled, and he sold his results to Ziegler."
鈴川"Results of stalled work. Specifically, what had he obtained?"
忠保"A completed replica human body. Only, the immune problem could not be solved. So the medical use they had hoped for was judged impossible."
鈴川"Exactly. Failed medical application, not an absence of results. Doctor Albrecht at Ziegler thought of using those results in tsurugi manufacture."
鈴川"The smith supplies two things: the body as the source of power, the soul as the intelligence to control it. Keep the two requirements separate."
鈴川"For the first, a copy body. For the second, a mechanical CPU and a program. Those were his successful substitutions."
鈴川"And now the new armor could be made in quantity. Not one lifetime, one product. Mass production had become possible."

鈴川 「これに先立つ二五四四年。 　何があったか知っている者？」
忠保 「はい」
鈴川 「稲城」
忠保 「大英連邦ブリテンのフォレット教授が研究していた 多重複写ミラー法による生体複製クローン技術開発が頓挫、 研究成果をゼグラー社に売却しました」
鈴川 「成果とは具体的に？」
忠保 「複製人体コピーボディの完成です。 　ただこれは、免疫問題を克服できなかった ため、期待されていた医療面での有効活用は 不可能と断定されました」
鈴川 「そう。 　だがゼグラー社のアルブリヒト博士はこの 技術を劔冑の製造工程に転用することを思い ついたわけだ」
鈴川 「劔冑は能力の源泉とするため、そして能力 を制御する知能とするために、鍛冶師自身の 心身を必要とする」
鈴川 「それを博士は前者を複製人体、後者を機械 式の演算装置ＣＰＵと命令系プログラムで代用することに成功」
鈴川 「量産可能な全く新しい劔冑を誕生させた」

en.html:
鈴川"Performance, however—here the new type was far below the old."
鈴川"Take a good old-type piece. Nobody wearing it, still it can receive instructions and act independently. Usually as a horse; useful for getting about."
鈴川"The new type cannot manage that. Cannot, yes. But insufficient for military use? No. Its abilities were quite sufficient."
鈴川"Most importantly, a precious technician no longer had to be consumed. That was what made the military men of every country sit up."
鈴川"Every country wanted the weapon. Adopt the technology, make it in quantity, improve it. Then improve again."
鈴川"Now many say the performance is coming close to the old type. We even have derivatives such as Racer Crus."
鈴川"As the new type spread, making the old declined just as rapidly. Surprising? Hardly."
鈴川"The knowledge dispersed. Today, they say, the method survives only among a limited few smiths of the dwarf race."
鈴川"So the battlefield belongs chiefly to the new type. Old armor, about the only users now are officers from distinguished families."
鈴川"Now let us straighten out the names. Listen properly. A failing mark is also available, if that is your preference."

鈴川"Back to our modern-contemporary boundary. Why does one theory begin with the dragoon? Okawa."
ｅｔｃ／大川"I don't know!"
鈴川"Excellent energy. Remain standing. Now, Doctor of Tsurugi, Inagi."
忠保"The strongest weapon had belonged only to those in power. Now the citizen class could possess it too."
鈴川"Correct. New technology, and the number of tsurugi grows explosively—"
鈴川"Explosively compared with before, mind. Ten suits, and you are already discussing the national budget. Rare goods they remain. Do not let one enthusiastic word remove that qualification."
鈴川"More armor now. Can the warrior class supply all the users? No. Where does the shortfall come from? Commoners."
鈴川"Previously supporting players in the military, commoners now received tsurugi and formed dragoon units. Give people power, and naturally their voice also gets louder."
鈴川"Yamato's dragoon units: Koryu 2. Removal of the property qualification for voting: Koryu 10, National Year 2569. Eight years only. Coincidence, this is not."
鈴川"The saying is that guns gave birth to democracy. Then the new-type tsurugi brought it up. Begin contemporary history with the dragoon, and this is the reasoning behind it."

鈴川 「話を近代と現代の区分に戻すぞ。 　つまり竜騎兵の登場をもって現代の皮切り とする説があるわけだが、その理由はわかる か？　大川」
ｅｔｃ／大川 「わかりません！」
鈴川 「元気があってよろしい。立ってろ。 　じゃあ劔冑博士の稲城」
忠保 「それまで権力者の占有物だった最強兵器が、 市民階級の手にも渡るようになったからです」
鈴川 「そうだ。 　新技術の誕生によって劔冑の数量が爆発的 に増え――」
鈴川 「と言っても十領造るだけで国家予算レベル の検討が必要になる、依然として希少な品で あることに変わりはないんだがな。 　あくまでそれ以前との比較の話だ」
鈴川 「劔冑の数量が増えると、使い手を士族階級 だけでまかなうわけにもいかなくなった。 　足りない分はどうする？　そう、平民だ」
鈴川 「それまで軍においては脇役でしかなかった 平民層出身者が劔冑を与えられ、竜騎兵部隊 を構成してゆく。 　そうして力を持てば当然、発言力も増す」
鈴川 「大和国軍における竜騎兵部隊の誕生が興隆 二年、選挙法から財産制限が撤廃されたのが 興隆十年……国紀二五六九年。この間わずか 八年というのは偶然でも何でもない」
鈴川 「銃が民主主義を生んだという言葉があるが、 ならば育て上げたのは新型劔冑というわけだ。 　竜騎兵の登場をもって現代とするのはこの 考え方に由来する」

Nothing decent, probably.

en.html:
鈴川"Democracy and nationalism grew. Peoples under colonial rule resisted the great powers, and resistance movements flourished."
鈴川"In response, Yamato appealed internationally for the abolition of racial discrimination. It tried to establish itself as Asia's leader, and met opposition from the British Commonwealth and the other white powers."
鈴川"The Yamato-Russian War did not, in the end, stop Russia's advance south. Yamato pushed onto the continent to counter it."
鈴川"The Commonwealth grew more alarmed. The course led toward the Great War..."
鈴川"At home, the dragoons' arrival strengthened the Rikuefu, the organization overseeing warriors. Before the war, it formed a national force alongside the Army and Navy: the Dragoon Army, commanding the capital region."
鈴川"...The birth of the Rokuhara Shogunate."
鈴川"Then the Great War. Europe, Asia, elsewhere—the fighting began. Yamato advanced on the continent and into the South Seas. Victory after victory at first; unifying Asia seemed close."
鈴川"But the Commonwealth sent its New World garrison toward the Pacific to meet the Yamato forces. It also moved the International League—"
鈴川"The International League for Unified Peace and Co-Prosperity was founded to settle disputes peacefully. In reality, as everyone knows, a supporters' association for the Commonwealth and its satellite states."
鈴川"With a League resolution, the Commonwealth formed the UNF. Their core remained its own New World troops, so the increase in fighting strength was not so large. Removing the supply worry, however, mattered greatly."
鈴川"Yamato had few resources and no foreign support. Once the quick, decisive victory was frustrated, it could not keep going. The front stalled..."
鈴川"Its forces were pushed back. Occupied territory was lost. Finally, the homeland itself became the battlefield. Defeat continued; Kyushu, Chugoku were invaded. Still, Rokuhara's army remained intact."
鈴川"Everyone believed Rokuhara only had to take the field, and the situation would reverse. And Rokuhara—"
鈴川"Made a historic decision without precedent in Yamato."
雄飛"..."

鈴川 「これを受ける格好で大和は人種差別思想の 撤廃を国際社会に訴え、アジアの盟主として の地位を確立しようと図ったが、大英連邦を 始め白人諸国の反発を買う」
鈴川 「ロシアの南下は和露戦争によっても結局は 止められず、大和はこれに対抗する形で大陸 進出を推進」
鈴川 「このことが大英連邦を更に警戒させ、大戦 へとつながっていく……」
鈴川 「国内では竜騎兵の誕生により、武者統括の 組織であった六衛府りくえふが勢力を拡大。 　大戦突入に先立って陸軍・海軍と並ぶ国軍 組織を形成、竜軍と称して首都圏を統監した」
鈴川 「……六波羅幕府の誕生だ」
鈴川 「そして大戦。欧州、アジア、その他の地域 でも戦争の火蓋が切って落とされた。 　大和軍は大陸と南洋へ進出し、序盤は連戦 連勝、アジア統一も間近かと思われた」
鈴川 「が、大英連邦は新大陸駐留軍を太平洋方面 へ向け、大和軍を迎撃させた。 　更には国際連盟を動かし――」
鈴川 「国際統和共栄連盟は国家間問題の平和的な 解決を目的として創られた組織だが、実質、 大英連邦とその衛星国家による協賛会でしか ないのは皆も知っている通りだ」
鈴川 「大英連邦は連盟の決議を得て連盟軍ＵＮＦを編成。 　戦力の中心はあくまでも自前の新大陸軍で、 そう増強されたわけでもないが、これにより 補給の不安が解消されたことの意味は大きい」
鈴川 「一方、資源に恵まれず、他国からの支援も ない大和側は、速戦即決の意図を挫かれると 後が続かなかった。 　戦線は膠着し……」
鈴川 「やがて大和軍は押し戻され、占領地を失い、 遂には本土決戦を迎える。 　敗勢はなおも続き、九州、中国と侵略され ……しかしまだ、六波羅軍は健在だった」
鈴川 「誰もが、六波羅さえ出撃すれば状勢は覆る と信じていた……。 　そして六波羅は」
鈴川 「大和史上に前例のない、歴史的決断を下す」
雄飛 「…………」

ja.html: 絶妙な皮肉だった。
ja.text: 絶妙な皮肉だった。

en.html:
鈴川"Rokuhara betrayed us."
鈴川"Abandoned the homeland. Surrendered to the League. Then became its vanguard and subdued Yamato. Burned towns, killed citizens, destroyed everything that resisted."
鈴川"So the war ended. Yamato was guaranteed a nominal measure of sovereignty, but placed under the League's GHQ. For changing sides, Rokuhara received the right to govern beneath it."
鈴川"Koryu 35. National Year 2594. Western Year 1934. ...Six years ago."
鈴川"Yes. Only six years have passed."

ja.html:
鈴川 「六波羅は裏切った・・・・・・・・」
鈴川 「祖国を見捨て、連盟軍に降伏した。 　その尖兵となって、大和を制圧した。町を 焼き、市民を殺し、逆らう全てを滅ぼした」
鈴川 「かくして大戦は終わり、大和は一応の主権 を保障されながらも、連盟の進駐軍司令部ＧＨＱの 管理下に置かれ……六波羅は寝返りの褒美に その下で大和の統治権を獲得する」
鈴川 「時に、興隆三五年。国紀二五九四年。外暦 一九三四年。 　……今から六年前のことだ」
鈴川 「そうだ。 　あれからまだ、六年しか・・・・経っていないのだ」
